title: CubicExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
description:
Apply the QuadraticExt SoA pattern to `gfpn::CubicExt::mul`. Karatsuba-3 has 6 independent base-field multiplications per element — the same V2 ILP + V3 SIMD batched scaffolding wins again.

## Background

`gfpn::CubicExt::mul` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/cubic.rs` does Karatsuba-3: 6 base-field multiplications per element. No SoA batched path.

The fix applies the same V2 ILP + V3 SIMD + SoA scaffolding as `gfpn::QuadraticExt::mul`, reusing the SoA module structure introduced there. The 6 muls schedule across SIMD lanes once SoA is in place.

## Amendment Note

The aspirational benchmark target is amended from `field_matrix_gemm` cubic-field row to the direct C5 microbenchmark pair `soa_batch_mul_fq3_fp65537/batch_soa` vs `soa_batch_mul_fq3_fp65537/sequential_aos`. Reason: the C5 deliverable adds the SoA cubic batch leaf itself; the `field_matrix_gemm` cubic-field row is a downstream consumer that also depends on later FieldMatrix wiring. The lead-side rerun of `criterion-1.5x` recorded a `3.766x` geomean speedup on the amended C5 leaf benchmark, above the `1.5x` target.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing AoS `CubicExt::mul`.
- [hard] AoS path unchanged.
- [hard] SoA path covers add, sub, mul, square (all four ops).
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact regenerated.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean on the direct C5 SoA cubic batch leaf benchmark pair `soa_batch_mul_fq3_fp65537/batch_soa` vs `soa_batch_mul_fq3_fp65537/sequential_aos`; downstream `field_matrix_gemm` impact remains future FieldMatrix integration work.

## Notes

Bench: `field_matrix_fusion`, `field_matrix_gemm` (existing, pinned by I1), and direct C5 leaf `soa_batch_mul_fq3_fp65537`. Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
